description: This file defines classes and methods related to workflow processing in the SmartClient framework, including classes like ProcessElement, ProcessSequence, Task, ServiceTask, ScriptTask, XORGateway, DecisionGateway, and UserTask, with associated methods for workflow execution and task management.

classes.name: ProcessElement
classes.description: Base class for workflow elements, providing properties and methods for workflow processing.

classes.name: ProcessSequence
classes.description: Represents a sequence of process elements, inheriting from ProcessElement.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Base class for tasks within the workflow, extending ProcessElement.

classes.name: ServiceTask
classes.description: Represents a service call task, extending Task, with methods to perform data source operations.

classes.name: ScriptTask
classes.description: Represents a script execution task, extending Task, with methods to execute custom scripts.

classes.name: XORGateway
classes.description: Exclusive OR gateway for decision branching in workflows.

classes.name: UserTask
classes.description: User interaction task, allowing editing and completion of user input within workflows.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific element by ID within a process.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins execution of the process workflow.
